A 16-bit instruction with all bits zero is permanently reserved as an illegal instruction.

_We reserve all-zero instructions to be illegal instructions to help trap attempts to execute zero-ed or non-existent portions of the memory space. The all-zero value_  _should not be redefined in any non-standard extension.
